title: Wanted to love this.
text: Wanted to love this.. I was so attracted to this online with the bright colors and bought it despite it being a small wreath.  I was really disappointed when I got it.  It is a full wreath for the size, but the colors in the wreath I received were dull and not spring-like at all.  It you want a small wreath with muted colors, this one might be the one for you.
